Remark
[curvature increase on the un-squeezed directions]

Source: petersen:page-0170 ↗ prop:pet-ch4-berger-cheeger-horizontal-lift ↗ thm:pet-ch4-oneill-formula For $X,Y\in \mathcal H_p$ (already horizontal for the $G$-action on $M$, hence also horizontal for the action on $G\times M$), $\mathrm{sec}_{g_\lambda }(X,Y)\ge \mathrm{sec}_g(X,Y)$, the excess coming from the nonnegative integrability-tensor correction in item 4 applied to the action on $G\times M$.
